name: ops-alert
doc: Teder hands an operator alert to Toran, which sends it on to the owner's WhatsApp (Toran src/ops/alertRoute.ts and src/ops/alert.ts, docs/operator.md section 6; Teder src/notify/operator.js, docs/operator-notes.md). It is between Teder and Toran alone, so it is not one of openfrequency-accounts' contracts: this file is kept byte for byte the same in both repositories' test/fixtures, and each side's test reads it.

routes.auth: Authorization: Bearer <OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN>, from this machine only, never through Caddy
